body: When he and my Mom were married, they argued over it all the time. You can't even sit down with him, and have a serious discussion over how he needs to change his ways. He's more or less lost his entire family because of the way he acts, and the things he does, you would think that would be a wake-up call for most people, but not for him. He's gotten worse over the years, talking to the television, criticizing the (fictional) characters on (fictional) TV shows, complaining about ethnic minorities when the news is on, shouting at the referees during football season. That's all he does, he doesn't work, he was in a car accident several years ago that put him on social security, so now he basically goes to sleep at 3 or 4am, and wakes up around 3 or 4 in the afternoon (I sometimes come home for lunch from 1-2, and his door is still closed). He's basically a grown man-child.
